text: The decision pits reduced origin demand against unmeasured stale-read behavior. The proposed update changes the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. A twenty-four-hour benchmark did observe eighteen percent fewer origin requests, so that evidence deserves weight; the narrower disagreement is that it cannot settle freshness, because the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence—the speedometer worked, the rear-view mirror did not. I therefore recommend a bounded course. In short: approve only a canary deployment, and require stale-read telemetry before any broader rollout.
